artist.name: Jessica Baio
artist.short_description: Jessica Baio — an Afterglow editorial selection for listeners exploring emotional pop.
artist.biography: Jessica Baio is an American singer-songwriter whose own website describes her as California-born and Utah-based. She developed an online audience by sharing covers while still a teenager, before shifting increasingly toward original material. Her official biography highlights the 2022 singles ‘at least’ and ‘trust issues’ as important in expanding that audience. Subsequent releases include the projects catalyst and petals, with songs such as ‘someday’ and ‘he loves me, he loves me not’. The same biography identifies UNSAID, released in November 2024 through 10K Projects, as her debut full-length album. It also describes a 2025 North American headline tour. For Afterglow, Baio belongs in a strand of emotional pop that emphasizes direct storytelling about relationships, doubt, and personal change. That genre description is editorial, not an official classification of every song. Her catalogue offers a range of short, memorable songs that can serve as entry points into deeper writing about individual experiences. Any statement about a particular song's meaning should rely on a song-specific source rather than this broader overview.
